funding_extreme.definition: Three-day mean annualized OKX perpetual funding; crowded positioning is treated contrarian.

oi_purge_flush.definition: A sharp one-day open-interest and price flush, active for no more than 48 hours.

breakout_20d.definition: Position of the daily close at the trailing 20-day price extremes.

box_position.definition: Price proximity to repeatedly tested 30-day support or resistance.

monday_asia.definition: Short window directional continuation from the preceding three days.

autocorr_gate.definition: Lag-one autocorrelation decides whether yesterday's direction tends to persist or reverse.

momentum_7d.definition: Seven-day BTC return mapped to five directional buckets.

sth_sopr.definition: Short-term-holder spent-output profitability combined with short-term-holder realized price.

etf_flow_5d.definition: Five-session net US spot-BTC ETF flow, with a recent sign-flip cap.

basis_regime.definition: Annualized front-quarter Deribit futures basis versus index price.

oil_shock.definition: Five-day WTI return used as a macro shock proxy.

dxy_trend.definition: Broad-dollar 20-day trend, enabled only when its BTC correlation is sufficiently negative.

nasdaq_risk.definition: Nasdaq-100 ten-day trend, enabled only in a positive BTC-equity correlation regime.

hy_spread.definition: US high-yield option-adjusted spread level and 20-day change; rapid widening can veto risk-on calls.

regime_stretch.definition: BTC versus its 200-day average, 90-day trend and Mayer-multiple extremes.

momentum_28d.definition: Twenty-eight-day BTC return mapped to five directional buckets.

net_liquidity.definition: Four-week change in Fed assets less reverse repo and Treasury cash balance.

stablecoin_30d.definition: Thirty-day change in aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply.

sth_rp_regime.definition: Three closes decisively above or below short-term-holder realized price.

fng_contrarian.definition: Seven-day mean Crypto Fear & Greed score interpreted contrarian at extremes.

mvrv_z.definition: Market-value to realized-value Z-score valuation regime.

hash_ribbons.definition: Thirty- versus sixty-day hashrate averages detect miner capitulation and recovery.

powerlaw_blend.definition: Blend of price versus the ladder centerline and lower floor; a floor break flags model risk.

dat_stress.definition: Operator-estimated digital-asset treasury mNAV and recent BTC sales.

polymarket_ye.definition: Operator-entered score from the prediction-market year-end median-to-spot ratio.

weekly_structure.definition: Weekly price versus the 20-week band and 200-week average, slope and RSI.

global_m2.definition: Change in a US/euro-area M2 year-over-year growth composite, optionally including operator CN/JP inputs.

gli_phase.definition: Operator-maintained Global Liquidity Index phase score.

attention_apathy.definition: Bitcoin Wikipedia attention percentile combined with fear/greed and price trend.

ism_regime.definition: Operator-entered ISM level and change mapped to the business-cycle rule.

pi_cycle.definition: Recent crossing of the 111-day average over twice the 350-day average.

liquidity_sweep.definition: Intraday sweep below the 20-day low followed by a close back above it; incubating only.
